transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp एक्सेलेरेसन
transcribe.description: transcribe.cpp (Whisper परिवार) मोडेलहरूका लागि हार्डवेयर एक्सेलेरेसन। Auto ले उपलब्ध भए GPU प्रयोग गर्छ (macOS मा Metal, Windows/Linux मा Vulkan)।

ort.description: ONNX मोडेलहरू (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, आदि) का लागि हार्डवेयर एक्सेलेरेसन। Windows मा DirectML प्रयोगात्मक छ। मोडेलहरूले ट्रान्सक्राइब गर्न नसक्न सक्छन्।

startHidden.label: लुकेर सुरु गर्नुहोस्

style.description: रेकर्डिङ ओभरले छान्नुहोस्: 'कुनै होइन' ले लुकाउँछ, 'मिनिमल' ले सानो पिल देखाउँछ, 'लाइभ' ले बोल्दै गर्दा वास्तविक समयमा ट्रान्सक्रिप्सन देखाउँछ (स्ट्रिमिङ-सक्षम मोडेलहरूमा मात्र — मोडेल पिकरमा स्ट्रिमिङ ब्याज हेर्नुहोस्)। Linux मा 'कुनै होइन' सिफारिस गरिन्छ।

position.title: ओभरले स्थिति
position.description: रेकर्डिङ र ट्रान्सक्रिप्सनका बेला ओभरले स्क्रिनमा कहाँ देखिन्छ।

pasteMethod.title: पेस्ट विधि
pasteMethod.description: टेक्स्ट कसरी घुसाइन्छ छान्नुहोस्। डाइरेक्ट: सिस्टम इनपुटमार्फत टाइपिङ अनुकरण गर्छ। कुनै होइन: पेस्ट नगरी हिस्ट्री/क्लिपबोर्ड मात्र अपडेट गर्छ।

typingTool.title: टाइपिङ उपकरण
typingTool.description: डाइरेक्ट पेस्ट विधिका लागि कुन Linux टाइपिङ उपकरण प्रयोग गर्ने छान्नुहोस्। Auto ले तपाईंको सिस्टमका लागि उपलब्ध उत्तम उपकरण स्वतः पत्ता लगाएर प्रयोग गर्छ।

clipboardHandling.title: क्लिपबोर्ड व्यवस्थापन
clipboardHandling.description: 'क्लिपबोर्ड परिवर्तन नगर्नुहोस्' ले ट्रान्सक्रिप्सनपछि तपाईंको हालको क्लिपबोर्ड सामग्री जोगाउँछ। 'क्लिपबोर्डमा कपी गर्नुहोस्' ले पेस्ट गरेपछि ट्रान्सक्रिप्सन नतिजा क्लिपबोर्डमा छोड्छ।

autoSubmit.title: स्वतः सबमिट
autoSubmit.description: टेक्स्ट घुसाएपछि चयन गरिएको कि संयोजन स्वतः पठाउनुहोस्। Cmd+Enter macOS मा लागू हुन्छ, भने Windows/Linux ले Super+Enter प्रयोग गर्छ।

translateToEnglish.label: अङ्ग्रेजीमा अनुवाद गर्नुहोस्

vadBackend.description: मौनता फिल्टर गर्न प्रयोग हुने डिटेक्टर छान्नुहोस्। Earshot प्रयोगात्मक हो; बोली काटिएमा वा आवाज रहिरहेमा Silero मा फर्कनुहोस्।

chineseScript.description: म्यान्डरिन र क्यान्टोनिज ट्रान्सक्रिप्सनलाई सरलीकृत वा परम्परागत अक्षरमा लेख्छ। अन्य भाषाहरू परिवर्तन हुँदैनन्।

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.intro: Each profile runs its own prompt and can have its own hotkey. Microphone, speech model, output and sound settings are shared. To translate, create a prompt that names the target language, then a dictation profile that uses it. Cleanup and the selected-text assistant are built in: you can edit them but not delete them. Profile hotkeys work even when Post Processing is off; that switch only controls the Cleanup hotkey.

upstreamImport.title: Import data from Handy
upstreamImport.description: Handy MaxLogic found data from the original Handy app. You can copy it into Handy MaxLogic now or later. The original Handy data is never changed.
upstreamImport.settings: Settings, shortcuts, prompts and custom sounds
upstreamImport.replacesSettings: Replaces this app's current settings, profiles and hotkeys. They will be lost.
upstreamImport.replacesHistory: Replaces this app's current history. Its entries will be lost.
upstreamImport.shortcutsNote: Both apps use the same default shortcuts, so with both running one key press records and pastes twice. Close the original Handy or change its shortcuts before using Handy MaxLogic.
upstreamImport.notNowNote: Not now: Handy MaxLogic asks again the next time it starts.
upstreamImport.declineNote: Don't import: Handy MaxLogic will not ask again. You can copy files by hand from {{path}}.
upstreamImport.nothingSelected: Select at least one item, or choose Not now or Don't import.
upstreamImport.cancelled: Import cancelled. Files that finished copying were kept. You can try again.
upstreamImport.resultModelsKept_one: {{count}} speech model was already present and was kept.
upstreamImport.resultModelsKept_other: {{count}} speech models were already present and were kept.
upstreamImport.resultLinksSkipped_one: Not copied because it is a link to a folder (copy it by hand if you need it): {{items}}.
upstreamImport.resultLinksSkipped_other: Not copied because they are links to folders (copy them by hand if you need them): {{items}}.
upstreamImport.restartNote: Restart Handy MaxLogic to use the imported data.
upstreamImport.recovery: These items were not copied, and the import will be offered again the next time Handy MaxLogic starts. Speech models already copied are skipped then, and settings and history are replaced only if you check them. Close the original Handy first, or copy the items by hand from {{source}} to {{destination}}.
upstreamImport.restartFailed: Restart failed: {{error}}. Close Handy MaxLogic and start it again.
